outbox_stale_finding.finding_classification: DEV-BOX WORKER NOT CONTINUOUSLY DRAINING — NOT a code defect
outbox_stale_finding.rationale: C8 reported outbox_stale_30s=742 with 439 events older than 1 day on the dev box. Static analysis of the dispatch lane shows the code IS sound: (1) DispatchDomainEventsJob.php:46 dispatches `onQueue('high')`. (2) Supervisor template `deploy/ansible/templates/supervisor-foodking.conf.j2` runs `queue:work redis --queue=high,default` numprocs=2 with autorestart. (3) Cron `foodking:outbox:rescue everyMinute` + `foodking:outbox:monitor everyMinute` + `foodking:outbox:retry-failed hourly` form a three-layer recovery net. (4) Crash-claim rescue lane (OutboxRescueCommand.php) explicitly handles the orphan window between Phase 1 and Phase 3b of DispatchDomainEventsJob. The 742 stale + 439 >1day are the EXPECTED state on a dev box where `php artisan queue:work` is not continuously running (per CLAUDE.md: V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne single-box file driver vs. dev macOS). Production deployment via Ansible supervisor will drain on first boot. C8 itself reached the same conclusion in its `interpretation` field.
outbox_stale_finding.production_evidence: Wave Polish stress (50 orders/3 concurrency/PASS 2026-05-21) ran on a continuously-draining lane and reported no outbox accumulation — proves the pipeline drains when worker is up.
outbox_stale_finding.owner_action_to_verify_in_prod: On Le Cayenne LOCAL box: `supervisorctl status foodking-queue:*` should show RUNNING for both processes; `php artisan tinker --execute='echo DB::table(\"domain_events\")->whereNull(\"dispatched_at\")->count();'` should return small number (<10).
outbox_stale_finding.v1_0_x_backlog_recommendation: Add a dev-onboarding doc snippet: `php artisan queue:work redis --queue=high,default --once` or `--max-jobs=10 --sleep=1` when devs want a one-shot drain of the local outbox. Already covered by `php artisan queue:work --once` mention in C8 owner_action_optional.

verdict_summary: All 9 production boot guards (CLAUDE.md §8) active and bit-identical to documented commits. Schedule() has 17 lanes — all use withoutOverlapping + onOneServer for cross-host serialization. Backup command Q14 implemented with 6y NF525 retention + restore drill doc + atomicity + sanity thresholds. Outbox pipeline has three-layer recovery (rescue everyMin + monitor everyMin + retry-failed hourly) + prune every day. Supervisor template (Ansible) drives 2 PHP queue workers + 1 Soketi process with autorestart + log rotation. Health endpoints implemented (live/ready/full) with DB + Redis + outbox staleness checks. Preflight command provides ops gate before symlink flip. C8 outbox_stale=742 finding is a dev-box worker-not-draining artifact, NOT a code defect — verified by static analysis of dispatcher + rescue lanes. NO V1 blocker found. Only 3 P2/P3 concerns flagged as V1.0.X backlog refinements.
